Players Committee card image of [[Stalker (V) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship that just moved from here (if within range).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe a41bae9] (5 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
